paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 7.47, representing a 4.92 percent increase from the prior close and an 18.38 percent increase over the last 23 trading sessions.

Fermi Inc. has recently been in the news due to its agreement with Hillcore Energy Capital to add 2.6 GW power capacity at its Texas AI campus, as reported by Seeking Alpha. This news was announced on August 11, 2026.

There have been several recent SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in convertible senior notes. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing and 10 new social media posts in the last 24 hours, with users expressing impatience regarding the stock price and anticipation for an upcoming call.
